description:
ShadowDragon is seeking a Junior AI/Machine Learning Engineer to support the development, testing, and continuous improvement of AI-powered capabilities across our data intelligence platform.

This role is designed for an early-career engineer with strong technical fundamentals, hands-on exposure to AI, and a genuine passion for building useful products with emerging technologies. You may have gained your experience through internships, academic work, workshops, bootcamps, open-source contributions, or independent projects. We value demonstrated curiosity and practical experience over a long list of credentials.

Working closely with senior engineers, you will contribute to prompt experimentation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, data preparation, model evaluation, automated testing, documentation, debugging, and AI service development. You will gain practical experience with large language models, embeddings, retrieval systems, AI agents, machine learning workflows, cloud services, and production engineering practices.

Quality is an important part of this role. As we expand our AI capabilities, we need reliable ways to evaluate outputs, automate regression testing, and integrate new functionality safely into our existing platform. We are therefore especially interested in candidates who are curious about both building AI features and validating that they work as intended.
title: Junior AI Engineer
qualifications: Up to two years of experience in AI engineering, machine learning, software engineering, data science, or a related technical area.
Relevant experience may come from internships, academic work, bootcamps, workshops, portfolio projects, hackathons, or open-source contributions.
Demonstrated experience completing one or more hands-on, end-to-end AI or machine learning projects.
Solid foundational Python programming skills.
Foundational understanding of machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, data processing, and model evaluation.
Familiarity with one or more tools or libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers, pandas, or NumPy.
Interest in LLMs, generative AI, prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic search, RAG, and AI agents.
Ability to work with both structured and unstructured data.
Comfort using Git, GitHub, command-line tools, notebooks, and APIs in a collaborative development environment.
Strong attention to detail, curiosity, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn from feedback.
Clear written communication skills for documenting technical work and experimental results.
A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for building useful, reliable AI-powered products.
You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to apply. Experience in any of the following areas would be valuable:
Project, academic, or internship experience involving LLMs, chatbots, semantic search, classification, summarization, automation, or other machine learning workflows.
responsibilities: Assist in developing and integrating AI-powered features using Python, LLM tools, machine learning libraries, APIs, and internal platform services.
Support prompt engineering, prompt testing, model comparison, and the systematic evaluation of AI-generated outputs.
Help design and maintain automated tests and regression-testing processes for AI features, services, and workflows.
Contribute to RAG workflows, including document preparation, chunking, metadata tagging, embedding generation, retrieval testing, and result evaluation.
Prepare, clean, format, sanitize, and validate structured and unstructured data used in AI experiments and model testing.
Review model outputs, identify errors and recurring patterns, compare approaches, and clearly document findings.
Write clean, readable, and maintainable Python code for scripts, prototypes, experiments, internal tools, and service components.
Support the debugging of AI workflows, data pipelines, API integrations, and model behavior under the guidance of senior engineers.
Work with existing codebases and services while following established development, testing, and review processes.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, team planning, and knowledge-sharing activities.
Learn and apply production engineering practices, including Git workflows, logging, testing, Docker, CI/CD, deployment fundamentals, and MLOps.
Clearly document experiments, implementation decisions, evaluation results, and technical recommendations.

description:
Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

Rocket Lab’s IT team is responsible for how our global teams access information and run operations across our computer systems, networks, and devices. Our hardworking IT team is a group of flexible problem-solvers working in a fast-paced environment but who also thrive under the challenge of supporting all of our proprietary systems and people, from finance to launch operations.

Based on-site at Rocket Lab& ">

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here .

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com. This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

description:
Ability to work East Coast hours required

Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

We’re not your traditional tech company and we don’t aim to be. Going against the grain is in our DNA. Building a revolutionary product begins with revolutionary thinking. That’s why we value diversity of background and lived experience. Together, we empower restaurants of all sizes to build great teams, increase revenue, improve operations, and delight their guests. We pair our deep understanding of the restaurant industry with powerful cloud based software and restaurant-grade hardware to deliver an intuitive all-in-one platform. Join us on our mission to empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.

Bready * to make a change?

Fintech at Toast operates one of the most critical portions of the Toast infrastructure: processing payments on behalf of our restaurants and ensuring that restaurants are paid in a timely manner. Payment processing is a key source of Toast’s revenue and also the lifeblood of our customers; we process millions of dollars in transactions per day.

We are seeking a Software Engineer II to join our Payments team. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of our unified payment processing solution. This platform offers a single, integrated service for payment acceptance across various channels and supports a configurable enterprise approach. It is designed to allow a build-once, available-to-all strategy for both existing and emerging payment methods.

About this roll * (Responsibilities)

• Design, build, and deliver features for Toast’s payments products

• Develop and implement automated test suite to ensure the code shipped to our customers meets the highest quality standards

• Roll* features out to customers, including monitoring for success

• Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features

• Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast

• Work with experienced engineers to deliver design and code review

Do you have the right ingredients* ? (Requirements)

• 2+ years of experience in designing and implementing robust backend services using Kotlin.

• Proven ability to develop scalable and secure APIs that integrate with various internal/external systems.

• Knowledge of best practices in API lifecycle management, including versioning, documentation, and deprecation strategies.

• Proficiency in Kotlin-specific frameworks and libraries for building efficient backend solutions.

• Demonstrated experience with microservices architecture and containerization technologies for enhanced scalability and maintainability.

Special Sauce * (Nice to Haves)

• Proficiency in DynamoDB

• Proficiency in Kotlin (or Java and willing to learn Kotlin) and Kotlin-specific frameworks and libraries for building efficient backend solutions

• Familiarity with AI-augmented development workflows and tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar)

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Spread* of Total Rewards
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits .

*bread puns encourage but not required!

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy .

Zone A

$133,000 — $213,000 USD

Zone B

$115,000 — $184,000 USD

Zone C

$104,000 — $166,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com .

-month plus coursework or projects in bioinformatics, NLP, machine learning, or full-stack web development
-month plus familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and containerized environments (Docker)
-month plus front-end development experience or coursework (React, Vue, or equivalent)
-month plus exposure to RESTful API design or web application development
Interest in NLP, text generation, or working with large language models
Interest in genomics, molecular diagnostics, bioinformatics, pharmacogenomics, or clinical laboratory data
Strong communication skills; both written and verbal
Show initiative and the ability to work independently under general supervision
Eagerness to learn how software engineering works inside a regulated life sciences environment where patient safety and accuracy are non-negotiable
responsibilities: Help wrap and operationalize existing bioinformatics literature-search and report-generation pipelines into production-grade RESTful or GraphQL APIs, working alongside senior engineers on integration patterns rather than net-new pipeline development
Contribute to API documentation, service contract definitions, and versioning strategies that support B2B integration with downstream clinical and consumer-facing systems
Assist with building observability, logging, and alerting into API surfaces to support production reliability and SLA compliance
Support connectivity between interpretive engines and external partner platforms in the wellness and clinical integrator space

Contribute to the language-generation layer for the PGx engine, helping convert structured CPIC/FDA rule outputs into physician-ready clinical summaries focused on dosage impacts and medication response guidance

Support development of the dynamic report generator for the Microbiome platform, producing patient-specific, wellness-oriented dietary observations and nutritional narratives aligned with the "food as medicine" framework

Help implement architectural guardrails across both platforms to prevent generation of non-approved clinical associations (PGx) and prohibited diagnostic disease claims (Microbiome), with validation at the model/template output layer
Work with PharmD, science, and regulatory teams to understand the boundary conditions that govern permissible output and how those constraints are encoded into the system

Contribute to building the self-service rule and literature updating workbench (internal tooling) that enables PharmD and science teams to manage clinical rules and reference literature without engineering dependency
Help develop the clinical review portal through which technical directors and pathologists validate, annotate, and sign off on AI-generated interpretations prior to report release
Support full-stack feature development spanning backend services, REST API endpoints, and responsive front-end interfaces with a focus on clinical clarity and workflow efficiency
Learn and apply healthcare-grade security requirements: PHI data handling, encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access control, and audit logging

description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer on GitLab's Subscription Lifecycle team within Monetization, you'll build the frontend experiences and backend services customers use to view and manage subscriptions, renew products, configure auto-renewal, and manage billing accounts. Your work will span renewals, overages and reconciliations, subscription visibility, and budget and reservation management, keeping subscription, billing, and account data accurate and reliable. Because these workflows directly affect revenue, customer access, and financial information, you'll use technical judgment, safe and iterative rollouts, and a high bar for reliability and correctness.

Some examples of our projects:

• Building a clear, reliable subscription view across the Customers Portal and related surfaces

• Improving manual renewal and auto-renewal flows, including supporting emails, banners, and account experiences

What you'll do

• Design and build fullstack features across the post-purchase subscription journey.

• Contribute to the technical design and implementation of new subscription lifecycle capabilities.

• Partner with Product and Design to translate renewal, billing account, and customer experience requirements into resilient, well-tested solutions.

• Integrate subscription lifecycle workflows safely with billing, customer account, and internal admin systems.

• Write maintainable, well-tested code and follow engineering practices for rollout safety and monitoring.

• Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback.

• Identify and reduce technical debt and architectural risk in the subscription lifecycle.

• Participate in incident response for subscription and renewal issues, given their potential impact on revenue and customer access.

• Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you'll bring

• Professional experience as a fullstack engineer and confidence working across frontend and backend code.

• Our purchase applications use Ruby on Rails (Must have) and Vue.js. (preferred) or React.

• Experience owning technical direction for a product area, including proposing, discussing, and driving thorough, iterative solutions.

• Experience building or maintaining transactional or checkout-style flows, ideally in a billing, ecommerce, or subscription context.

• Familiarity integrating with third-party billing or customer relationship management systems, such as Zuora, Salesforce, or Stripe, is a plus, not a requirement.

• A focus on safe, incremental delivery given the revenue and customer impact of this work.

• The ability to communicate clearly and concisely about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems and propose thorough, iterative solutions.

• Written and spoken English proficiency sufficient to collaborate in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.

• Alignment with GitLab's values and a commitment to working in accordance with them.

About the team

The Subscription Lifecycle team is part of GitLab's Monetization section and owns the post-purchase subscription experience. You'll partner with Sales, Finance, Information Technology, and Support on secure, reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows, and report to the Engineering Manager, Purchase. The team works asynchronously, with regular planning and retrospectives and shared expectations for deployments, incident management, testing, and rollout safety. GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute and co-create the software that powers our world. The Purchase team's mission is to make it as easy as possible for anyone to buy, add on to, or upgrade GitLab through a single, trustworthy, unified purchase experience. For more on how Monetization works, see the Monetization sub-department handbook .

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

• All remote, asynchronous work environment

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Team Member Resource Groups

• Equity Compensation and Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Growth and development budget

• Parental leave

• Home office support

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

title: Software Engineer, Connect
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

Vercel Connect helps developers give agents and AI-built apps secure access to the data, tools, and events they need—without wrestling with OAuth, credentials, and integration complexity. We’re currently building two things: 1) a platform for managing agent identity, access and permissions and 2) a set of rich connectors for the 1000s of systems (like Linear, Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.) that agents will need to talk to.

We’re solving core problems like agent identity and delegated access, tool approval and standards around making agents aware of changes on 3rd party platforms.

As a senior engineer on this team you'll not only own our APIs, token infrastructure, authorization, SDKs, and more, but work with external companies to make it easier for developers to build agents that integrate with their products. You’ll need to balance both high uptime and fast performance with flexibility to allow for seamless connection to many systems that weren’t designed with agents in mind. If you’re looking for a role that will put you at the center of how agent identity and credentials work, this is it! This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, in the office on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday.

What You Will Do:

• Ship provider integrations end to end — auth flows, token exchange, app registration, and the configuration UI — from generic API-key and OAuth presets through bespoke cases like Snowflake Partner Connect, Slack manager apps, and Microsoft Entra.

• Own and improve our infrastructure (uptime, performance, secure storage of credentials and keys) and developer experience for Connect

• Work with industry leaders within and outside of Vercel to propose and implement new authentication and authorization protocols for AI era

• Build and harden event forwarding — signature verification inbound, project-scoped identity outbound, delivered to the right deployment and environment.

• Make Connect the obvious way to give an agent a credential, extending the SDKs , consent-redirect flow, and framework adapters.

• Reduce the cost of the next hundred integrations, so most new providers become configuration rather than code.

About You:

• 6+ years building and operating production backend or full-stack systems, with a track record of owning a service or platform surface rather than a feature.

• You deeply understand your users problems and work in a focused manner to address them, leveling up the product you’re working on over time.

• Deep, practical understanding of OAuth 2.0/2.1, OIDC, and JWTs — not just wiring up a client library, but reasoning about authorization codes, PKCE, refresh semantics, audience and scope restriction, token exchange, and what each of those actually protects against.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

  • Strong TypeScript, and comfort developing backend and frontend components.
  • Experience integrating with many third-party APIs, an appetite for the reality of it — undocumented behavior, non-compliant OAuth, inconsistent errors — and the judgment to absorb that mess behind a clean abstractions

description:
Software Engineer, Growth (Early Career)

Location

San Francisco, California

Employment Type

Full time

Department

Early Career

Overview

Application

Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

This is NOT a new grad role! This role is for candidates with 0-2 YOE and can start full time right away.

About the Role

As an Early Career Software Engineer at Notion, you’ll help shape core user experiences and accelerate how people discover value in Notion. You'll tackle meaningful challenges with increasing autonomy, crafting code that millions of users will experience. You'll take ownership of projects that matter, make critical technical decisions, and contribute your unique perspective to our product vision. Working alongside passionate experts across design, product, and data, you'll help shape the future of how people work.

We’re hiring early career engineers to join us across several teams at Notion. Your recruiter will partner with you to find the team that aligns best with your interests and where you can make the highest impact.

What You’ll Achieve

Plan, build, and ship product features from conception to launch, then iterate based on insights and customer feedback.

Improve performance, reliability, and quality of key experiences used by millions of users and thousands of organizations.

Run experiments that drive activation, retention, collaboration, and revenue, partnering with design, data science, and research.

Build internal tools and platform improvements that help all engineers ship quickly and safely.

Contribute to team norms, code quality, and a culture of learning and thoughtful tradeoffs.

Areas you might work on

Acquisition: Landing pages, signup/auth flows, pricing + plan selection, workspace creation, invitations during onboarding, and experiments that improve conversion and time-to-value.

Adoption / Activation: In-product education, templates, reminders, onboarding tours, lifecycle nudges, and measurement frameworks that increase depth of use, retention, and habit formation.

Experimentation & Measurement (cross-cutting): A/B testing infrastructure, analytics event quality, dashboards, and iteration loops that let teams learn quickly and ship confidently.

Skills You'll Need to Bring

You have less than two years of engineering experience. You have solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems, with a customer-minded, pragmatic approach to solving problems.

Thoughtful problem-solving: You approach problems holistically, starting with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You think about the implications of what you're building and how it will impact real people's lives. You can navigate ambiguity successfully, decompose complex problems into clean solutions, while also balancing the business impact of what you’re building.

Impact-driven approach to technology: You see technologies as tools to achieve user impact rather than ends in themselves. You care more about building successful systems that solve real problems than about using specific tech stacks or following trends. You stay current with the latest tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and other AI-assisted development environments, you're pragmatic about choosing the right tool for the job, focusing on what delivers the most value to users and the business.

Proactive communication and high agency: You own your work, communicating clearly about progress and blockers. You don't wait for instructions for every step but rather show initiative in identifying what needs to be done and driving projects forward. You ask questions when needed while independently finding solutions to problems.

Nice to Haves

You have experience with any part of our technology stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Postgres, and Elasticsearch.

You care about the interaction between technology and society, the ways in which they inform each other, and our responsibility as technologists to be conscious of that relationship.

You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated salary range for this role is $130,000 - $150,000

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

MITRE’s Systems Performance and Evaluation Department is charged to solve some of our nation's most critical challenges in delivering services to citizens throughout defense and intelligence, aviation, homeland security, the judiciary, healthcare, and cybersecurity domains.

Job Description:

This is an opportunity for an Associate Data Scientist with an interest in advancing and applying innovative data science and analytical techniques to help solve some of our nation's most critical challenges. We are looking for highly motivated, adaptive, and self-directed candidates with motivation to join our technical workforce, expand their technical skills and capabilities, and grow our work supporting the development and deployment of nationally important solutions through Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Model-Based Systems Engineering, Digital Engineering, Systems Architecture and Requirements Engineering, and System-of-Systems and Systems Thinking practices.

As an Associate Data Scientist, you will leverage and grow your analytical, mathematical, data science, and systems engineering expertise to support the analysis, design, implementation, and integration of enterprise systems and systems-of-systems, as well as mission analysis for federal agencies.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Using your understanding of data science, systems and mission engineering, quantitative methods, and an awareness of sponsor needs to determine areas where MITRE can have an impact

• Applying modern methods and tools such as Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Model-Based Systems Engineering, Digital Engineering, Mission Engineering, and Mathematical Modeling to assess capability needs, requirements, architecture, designs, performance constraints and gaps, proposed changes, and verification and test approaches

• Evaluating and comparing alternative architectures and approaches using qualitative and quantitative techniques; exploring large trade-spaces and analyzing trade-offs

• Identifying and developing metrics and analytical methods to measure and analyze relevant system and data properties, such as robustness, resiliency, interoperability, quality, and maintainability

• Supporting requirements management, interface management, and architecture change management processes

• Performing data analysis, modeling, and system design and development, including software development, systems modernization, and architecture

• Supporting multiple tasks across several government-sponsored projects in a small- to large-team environment

Basic Qualifications:

• Typically requires less than 1 year of related experience with a related bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.

• Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

• Familiarity with programming languages and analytical tools such as Python and MATLAB

• Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Digital Engineering (DE) concepts

• Experience with statistical analysis, data analysis, and modeling

• Interest in complex, multi-disciplinary data and analytical problems

• Willingness and ability to learn new tools and concepts in a variable environment of government sponsors

• This position requires a minimum of 3 days a week on-site.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Preference given to qualified candidates with active clearance

• Advanced degree in related field of study

• Experience with multi-disciplinary modeling and simulation (physics-level, engineering-level and/or socio-technical-level)

• Experience with Digital Engineering integration through internship, research, or academic projects

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

None

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

None

$80,000 - $100,000 - $120,000 Annual

Work Location Type:

Onsite

Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit www.bugcrowd.com .

Bugcrowd is looking for a motivated Customer Support Engineer I to join our growing Bugcrowd Support team. In this role, you will be an initial point of contact for both Customers and Researchers for all questions and issues regarding interactions and usage of the Bugcrowd Security Knowledge Platform. The ideal candidate is a quick and eager learner, a diligent professional, and an effective communicator, focused on developing cross-functional relationships.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Initial Technical Support: Serve as the first point of contact for customer and researcher issues across tickets, email, and video channels, resolving standard L0–L2 technical questions.

• Knowledge & Documentation: Identify and apply established workarounds for common issues while documenting repeatable solutions in the Knowledge Base.

• Workflow Optimization: Assist in refining internal operational workflows and documentation to increase resolution efficiency.

• Guided Professional Growth: Work under the regular guidance of senior team members, proactively seeking feedback and coaching to develop technical skills and independence.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Experience: 0–2 years of experience in a technical support, customer-facing, or technology-adjacent environment.

• Technical Foundations: Familiarity with command-line tools (e.g., Bash, SSH, grep) and foundational exposure to integrations such as Jira, SAML, APIs, or SSO/2FA.

• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication abilities with a focus on clear, professional documentation.

• Problem-Solving Mindset: A solutions-oriented approach with strong time management, composure under pressure, and a high sense of urgency.

Preferred Experience

• Security Interest: Demonstrated interest in cybersecurity concepts, vulnerability types, or ethical hacking.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements
The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.
Sitting and / or standing - Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time
Carrying and / or lifting - Must be able to carry / move laptop as needed throughout the work day.
Environment - remote, work-from-home 100% of the time.

Pay Range Disclosure
The base pay range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to Qualifications, Geographical Location, Education/certifications, Experience, Skill Sets, Training, and other business and organizational needs.

At Bugcrowd, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for the position is: $59,520 - $74,400.

This position may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary bonus program or commission plan, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Culture

• At Bugcrowd, we understand that diversity in the workplace is vital to a company’s success and growth. We strive to make sure that people are included and have a sense of being part of making Bugcrowd not only a great product but a great place to work.

• We regularly hear from both customers and researchers that Bugcrowd feels like a family, and we strive to maintain that internally as well.

• Our team consists of a broad range of people: musicians, adventure sports junkies, nature lovers, parents, cereal enthusiasts, night owls, cyclists, artists—you get the point.

At Bugcrowd, we are solving security threats and vulnerabilities that are relevant to everyone, therefore we believe solving these problems takes all kinds of backgrounds. We value the perspectives and experiences people from underrepresented backgrounds bring.

About the Role

As an Associate Reliability Engineer, you will ensure the resilience and availability of Kohl’s systems and applications. You will drive incident response efforts, perform root cause analysis and implement preventative measures to enhance system reliability. Through automation and process improvements, you will help establish consistent practices that elevate our operational excellence.

What You’ll Do

• Follow software lifecycle driving reliability, observability and efficiency across product teams within your domain

• Identify repeated toil and find opportunities for automation

• Remain part of an on-call rotation to respond to production incidents and conduct blameless retros and root-cause analyses (RCAs) to drive a culture of continuous improvements

• Proactively identify failures before they cause outages by using chaos engineering techniques such as edge cases, failure modes and design review

• Additional tasks may be assigned

What Skills You Have

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in MIS, Computer Science or related field

• Programming skills in one or more languages (Java, Python, Go or Node.js)

• Basic knowledge of systems architecture, operating system internals and network fundamentals

• Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure)

• Basic knowledge of continuous integration, continuous deployment and test-driven development

• Basic understanding of containerization and container orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher)

• Basic understanding of configuration management (e.g., Chef, Ansible, Puppet)

• Familiarity with monitoring techniques and tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Tracing)

description:
At StarTree we're a group of passionate individuals that desire to improve the lives of many by developing tools and technologies that support availability and speed in the world of real-time analytics.

Our aim is to make it simple for every company to delight their users - external and internal - and create new revenue streams from their data, by building the world’s most comprehensive and accessible cloud analytics system.

At StarTree we're a group of passionate individuals that desire to improve the lives of many by developing tools and technologies that support availability and speed in the world of real-time analytics.

Our aim is to make it simple for every company to delight their users - external and internal - and create new revenue streams from their data, by building the world’s most comprehensive and accessible cloud analytics system.

Team and Responsibilities

Apache Pinot is a distributed analytics database built for real-time applications at massive scale . It powers mission-critical workloads at companies including Splunk, Meesho, CrowdStrike, Together AI, and Charter Telecom , where milliseconds matter and scale is measured in millions of events and tens of thousands of queries per second.

CrowdStrike processes up to 120K events/sec and serves 25K queries/sec ; Together AI analyzes billions of LLM token events per hour with sub-second latency; and Charter Telecom operates Pinot at an ingestion scale of 120M events/sec . These aren't just benchmarks—they are production systems powering real customer experiences.

At StarTree, you’ll work on the distributed systems behind this scale—solving hard problems in performance, reliability, concurrency, and data infrastructure. You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact from day one, take ownership of meaningful problems, and grow rapidly in a high-ownership startup environment.

You Will

• Own and drive impactful distributed systems problems end-to-end, from inception through production launch.

• Collaborate with a strong engineering team to identify and prioritize the most impactful problems and projects for the company.

• Raise the quality bar across engineering while helping keep our systems reliable and operationally lean.

• Mentor and grow engineers while learning from experienced, battle-tested engineers around you.

Skills & Experience

• Experience- 0-2 Years.

• Strong distributed systems fundamentals and experience solving problems at scale. Our platform is Java-based, so Java experience is a plus, but not a hard requirement.

• Bias toward execution — able to take an idea from concept through implementation and deliver it to production.

• Deep ownership of quality and customer experience , with a strong focus on reliability, observability, performance, and ease of use.

• Adaptability and flexibility — willing to take on whatever is most important for the company and adjust to changing priorities.

• Curiosity, positivity, and resilience — comfortable navigating ambiguity and uncertainty while maintaining a constructive, problem-solving mindset.

AI-First Mindset - Comfortable using AI tools in everyday engineering workflows and eager to continuously learn and integrate AI into how you build, debug, test, and solve problems.

About StarTree:

StarTree is a cloud-based software company that enables business customers to derive advanced insights from real-time and historical data. StarTree was founded by the core software engineering team and inventors of Apache Pinot , which currently powers hundreds of user-facing applications at companies across industries, including LinkedIn, Uber, Target, 7Eleven, Etsy, Walmart, WePay, Factual, Weibo, and more. StarTree Cloud has enabled even more companies to deploy and operate real-time analytics at scale, including Stripe, Sovrn, Roadie, Just Eat Takeaway.com, Dialpad, Guitar Center, Blinkit, and more.

StarTree is backed by leading investors including GGV Capital, Sapphire Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, CRV, and Citi”

description:
At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget.

Our Science & Technology directorates include National Security, Integrated Discovery Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus.

The Integrated Discovery Sciences Directorate (IDSD) leads fundamental research across biology, chemistry, earth and environmental sciences, materials science, advanced computing, artificial intelligence , quantum information science, mathematics, autonomy, and DOE national user facilities. Our vision is to accelerate scientific discovery by observing, understanding, simulating, predicting, and controlling dynamic biotic-abiotic processes and interactions within complex biological, chemical, material, and Earth systems. We intentionally connect disciplines to advance fundamental discovery science, develop transformative scientific capabilities, and address the nation's most important challenges in energy, environmental resilience, biotechnology, advanced manufacturing, health, and national security.

title: Developer Advocate, Payload
location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

At Figma, we're building a vibrant community where designers and product builders come together to learn, grow, and connect around their shared passion. Our Advocacy team is central to this mission—empowering our users through engaging content, meaningful interactions, and genuine advocacy.

We're looking for a Developer Advocate focused on Payload to partner closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Product teams. You'll bring deep design expertise, strong product intuition, and a genuine love for the design and developer community into our go-to-market strategies. You'll also champion our users' voices internally, ensuring their perspectives shape our product evolution.

This is a full-time role that can be held from our New York City or San Francisco hub, or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

• Advocate for Payload : Promote Payload and the Payload + Figma integrations to developers inside and outside Figma.

• Empower Payload connections : Collaborate closely with Sales and Customer Experience teams to help customers unlock the full potential of Payload across real product workflows.

• Engage with the Payload community: Triage GitHub issues and community PRs, including labeling, reproducing and routing them, and working with engineering on review and prioritization.

• Create compelling content : Create technical content for Payload + Figma products: tutorials, demos, videos, starter templates and livestreams.

• Inspire community connections : Foster meaningful relationships within the Payload community, identify collaboration opportunities, and nurture user-driven initiatives.

• Speak and engage at events and in co-marketing : Regularly present at industry meetups, conferences, and community events, sharing practical insights from real-world design work.

• Champion user voices : Stay attuned to community feedback, sentiment, and emerging design trends—advocating internally to inform product decisions and improvements.

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

• Have deep, hands-on expertise with Payload and experience integrating it within real product teams.

• Are comfortable operating in evolving workflows, including CMS, DAM, design systems, and AI-assisted design or prototyping.

• Are passionate about engaging with and contributing to the design or developer community.

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

• An entrepreneurial mindset, with the enthusiasm and ability to transform early-stage ideas into polished, impactful outcomes

• The flexibility and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time to engage with the Payload community in person

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.

Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.

Annual Base Salary Range:

$115,000 — $269,000 USD

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status , or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com . These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:

• Holding interviews in an accessible location

• Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing

• Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers

• Changing the mode or format of interviews

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice .

• Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.

• Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

Servco is hiring a Data Engineer I to build and support defined data pipelines for Hawaii Mobility. Working with internal systems and external APIs, the role helps transform, model, test, and document data so reporting, operations, and AI teams can rely on it.

Reporting to the Manager, Data Engineering, within the Data Visualization, Analytics & Automation function led by its Director under the VP, Data & AI, this is an individual contributor role with coaching and code review. The engineer develops familiarity with Servco systems and takes on work with increasing independence.

Build, test, document, and maintain defined ingestion and transformation pipelines with guidance and review. Assist with models, mappings, integration checks, lineage, and data quality for reporting and AI-ready data.

Support deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of pipelines; escalate complex incidents and help with critical operations as needed.

Partner with Analytics Engineers and senior Data Engineers to make governed data available and understandable for reporting and AI use cases, following approved solution designs.

Help investigate data quality exceptions, record root causes and fixes, and keep source mappings and operating notes current under senior guidance.

Assist with metadata, definitions, access requests, and lineage so downstream users can find and trust approved data.

Learn Servco business systems, Databricks, Azure, Python, SQL, Git workflows, testing, and documentation through coached delivery.

Follow governance and secure data handling standards while steadily expanding ownership and seeking feedback.

Listen to operators and learn how customer, sales, service, and finance data supports day-to-day decisions; use feedback to improve the assigned data work.

description:
GAQ327R264

At Databricks Information Technology, we are a product-led organization transforming the way we work, from how easy it is to use our IT services to the applications we develop to help us scale seamlessly amid incredible growth.

As a Software Engineer, Infrastructure , you will be a core technical contributor on the IT CorpEng Infrastructure team, owning and driving the evolution of our core infrastructure and observability platforms. This role requires a strong software engineering mindset, deep technical breadth across SRE and infrastructure worlds, and the ability to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for currently "immature" system problems. You will be responsible for building resilient, scalable, and automated infrastructure that empowers our development teams. • Automate: Develop and deploy production-grade infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS preferred) using Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

• CI/CD Excellence: Build and maintain robust deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, including both cloud-hosted and self-hosted runners for specialized build requirements.

• Drive "Observable by Default" Frameworks: Implement infrastructure standards to ensure new internal applications are secure, with logging, metrics, and tracing configured out of the box.

What We Look For

• Software Engineering Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and tooling (required).

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Solid working knowledge of Terraform (modules, state management) or Pulumi (preferred).

• Cloud & Containerization: Hands-on experience building and supporting production workloads in AWS (or Azure/GCP), along with Kubernetes and Docker fundamentals.

• CI/CD & Automation: Practical experience designing, maintaining, and troubleshooting pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar modern CI/CD tools.

• Observability Foundations: Practical understanding of observability pillars (logging, metrics, tracing) and hands-on experience integrating tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.

• Independent Execution: Proven ability to own end-to-end tasks with guidance from Tech Leads, breaking down broader technical goals into actionable technical solutions.

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here .

$136,300 — $187,450 USD

title: Machine Learning Engineer 2
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

About the job

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets.

• Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking

• Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships.

• Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.

• Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

• Experience building backend services, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the problem demands.

• A curious approach to service management: ability to investigate how systems actually behave in production, and desire to continuously learn how to operate them with rigor and accountability.

• Experience building or working with evaluation/quality-measurement systems, such as regression detection or quality metrics, or the desire to learn.

• Solid grounding in observability practices: structured logging, metrics, and using them to debug distributed systems in production.

• Fluency with AI-assisted dev tools (e.g. agents for code generation, review, debugging), applied with deliberate direction and critical thinking.

Desired:

• Experience with Go and/or Python.

• Experience with event-streaming systems (e.g. Kafka).

• Experience building LLM-backed products.

• Practical experience applying ML, e.g. building, evaluating, or productionizing models.

Location

• This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

• Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,560 - $160,700

• Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000 - $170,000.

• This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, 2026 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, ! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Software Engineer, Ad Signals
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

We are seeking a senior backend software engineer to help build the app conversion signals that power Reddit’s app advertising business. You will work on MMP integrations, SKAN processing, and App CAPI to make app installs and in-app events more reliable, useful, and easier for advertisers to integrate.

Role Description:

Advertisers depend on conversion signals to understand campaign performance and guide investment. Missing events, duplicate delivery, inconsistent mappings, and difficult integrations can undermine that trust. Your work will improve the systems and diagnostics that make app signals usable for measurement and downstream ads systems.

Responsibilities:

• Own backend projects across MMP, SKAN, and App CAPI, from requirements and design to implementation, rollout, and ongoing operation.

• Build scalable ingestion and processing services with clear contracts, validation, deduplication, failure recovery, and data lineage.

• Develop integration tooling and diagnostics that help advertisers and partners identify and resolve signal delivery problems.

• Analyze signal quality and delivery metrics, investigate discrepancies, and prioritize improvements with product and data science partners.

• Work with partner engineering and downstream consumers to evolve schemas and integrations without disrupting existing advertisers.

• Incorporate privacy and security requirements into system design, and maintain controls throughout the data lifecycle.

• Raise engineering quality through testing, design reviews, incident learning, and mentorship.

Required Qualifications:

• Demonstrated senior-level backend software engineering experience delivering and operating scalable production systems.

• Hands-on app ads signals or mobile measurement experience, with depth in MMP integrations, SKAN, or app conversion APIs.

• Strong programming, API design, distributed systems, and SQL skills, supported by independent problem solving and data investigation.

• Clear communication and a record of delivering results with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Benefits:

• 100% remote opportunity (we have 4 office locations for hybrid/onsite work preference in NY, SF, LA and Chicago)

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

#LI-AJ1

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ .

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. descriptionHtml:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are seeking a senior backend software engineer to help build the app conversion signals that power Reddit’s app advertising business. You will work on MMP integrations, SKAN processing, and App CAPI to make app installs and in-app events more reliable, useful, and easier for advertisers to integrate.

Role Description:

Advertisers depend on conversion signals to understand campaign performance and guide investment. Missing events, duplicate delivery, inconsistent mappings, and difficult integrations can undermine that trust. Your work will improve the systems and diagnostics that make app signals usable for measurement and downstream ads systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Own backend projects across MMP, SKAN, and App CAPI, from requirements and design to implementation, rollout, and ongoing operation.
  • Build scalable ingestion and processing services with clear contracts, validation, deduplication, failure recovery, and data lineage.
  • Develop integration tooling and diagnostics that help advertisers and partners identify and resolve signal delivery problems.
  • Analyze signal quality and delivery metrics, investigate discrepancies, and prioritize improvements with product and data science partners.
  • Work with partner engineering and downstream consumers to evolve schemas and integrations without disrupting existing advertisers.
  • Incorporate privacy and security requirements into system design, and maintain controls throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Raise engineering quality through testing, design reviews, incident learning, and mentorship.

Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated senior-level backend software engineering experience delivering and operating scalable production systems.
  • Hands-on app ads signals or mobile measurement experience, with depth in MMP integrations, SKAN, or app conversion APIs.
  • Strong programming, API design, distributed systems, and SQL skills, supported by independent problem solving and data investigation.
  • Clear communication and a record of delivering results with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
