title: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
CSQ427R339

Associate Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Hub Cities: NYC | Mountain View | up to 20% travel to customer sites + Hybrid office expectation

As an Associate Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Databricks, you'll be in a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to build and productionize Data & AI solutions on the Databricks platform. This early-career role is ideal for a strong Software Engineer looking to grow into a Forward Deployed Engineer. You will embed with customer teams, ship production-grade systems, and learn the Databricks platform deeply alongside Senior FDEs and our Engineering organization.

The impact you will have:

• Production Solution Delivery: Deliver production-grade systems and reference architectures, contributing reusable frameworks, tools, and best practices along the way.

• Transformational Impact: Support strategic customers through transformational data & AI projects, from prototype through production deployment.

• Own the Architecture: Contribute to architecture and design decisions for secure, scalable, full-stack solutions on the Databricks platform.

• Embed with customer teams to understand their technical and business challenges and help deliver measurable impact.

• Collaborate closely with senior FDEs, Databricks engineering, and customer support to unblock customers and feed learnings back into the product.

• Manage technical scope and timelines for your workstreams, growing toward end-to-end delivery ownership.

• Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.

What we look for:

• 2+ years of experience in a Software Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, or AI Engineering role

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering

• Strong full-stack software engineering skills proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, and comfort working across back-end services, APIs, and modern front-end frameworks.

• Solid Computer Science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.

• Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), or a strong desire to develop cloud expertise quickly.

• Familiarity with CI/CD, and an interest in production data architectures and MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs.

• Excellent communication skills and a genuine interest in customer-facing engineering work.

• Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.

• Experience with Apache Spark or distributed data processing is a plus.We'll help you build platform depth on the job.

• Databricks Certification is a plus, and can be obtained after joining.

Recent graduate?: We’d love for you to explore our current internship openings on our careers page and submit your application for our roles designed for new college graduates.

About Databricks

Databricks is a Data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide rely on Databricks to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe, and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow.

This role is based in one of our US Hub cities. Travel to customers is expected approximately 20% of the time.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Solutions Engineer, Okta (Enterprise West)
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Solutions Engineer, US Enterprise (West)

San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; San Diego, CA; Seattle, WA

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Solutions Engineering Team

We believe Solutions Engineers at Okta are involved in all stages of the customer’s digital transformation. Solutions Engineers are experienced using presentations, email, phone and social media to connect with customers virtually and in-person. We are looking for great teammates who can build and deliver sales presentations and customized product demonstrations to help educate Okta’s Customers (everyone from developers to product managers to C-level executives) on best practices during their cloud security technology journey. We believe Okta’s Solutions Engineers empathize with Customers and quickly discern their true technical needs by asking detailed, clarifying questions while presenting solutions that specifically address those needs. Okta Solution Engineers have the rare combination of technical acumen and business insight; in a career where you can utilize both. As a Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will further develop each of these skills by advising a diverse set of customers on the value they will gain by using Okta’s Identity Platform.
The Solutions Engineer Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Manager Solutions Engineering, Okta the Solutions Engineer is a functional business consultant,  with a passion for technology and the advanced ability to develop, position and demonstrate product-specific solutions during sales cycles, while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

What you’ll be doing

• Work alongside the sales team as the technical and domain expert of a customer-facing sales team to help Customers understand the value of Okta’s solutions

• Understand customer challenges and business issues and provide product demonstrations to align our solutions with customer needs

• Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, partners and Okta colleagues

• Plan and deliver Proof Of Concepts for customers who have more complex use cases, collaborating with other Okta engineering teams as needed

• Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value

• Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solutions Engineers to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

• Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

• Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

• At times, be asked to learn and lead your team as a subject matter expert (SME) with various product solutions and/or competitive knowledge

What you’ll bring to the role

• 4+ years pre-sales engineering experience and solution selling.

• A passion to serve the Customer, demonstrated in a customer-facing role, such as presales or professional services, but ideally in a pre-sales capacity.

• An ability to quickly communicate complex ideas around a technical topic, ideally on the fly, using a whiteboard.

• Deployed apps in cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, Vercel, etc.

• Experience with at least one standard network security protocol. (eg. OAuth, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP)

• Experience working with REST APIs and SDKs

• Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: web (JavaScript, HTML, frontend frameworks) development, backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python) development, scripting (Bash, Powershell, Perl)

• An understanding of core security concerns within a typical application. (password hashing, SSL/TLS, encryption at rest, XSS, XSRF)

• You're an exceptional communicator, adept at simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, including highly skilled experts in large group settings.

• A confident and articulate presenter, you excel at sharing knowledge and insights with experienced technical professionals and large expert audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical information to highly skilled and experienced audiences, whether one-on-one or in large presentations.

• Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterparts to guide execution excellence

• Diagramming experience for user journey flows, complex architecture diagrams, etc.

• Typically 25% travel.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or equivalent experience

You ideally have

• Proven experience designing, implementing, and managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions in enterprise environments.

• Deep understanding of the challenges and best practices associated with securing privileged accounts, including just-in-time (JIT) access, session recording, credential vaulting, and secrets management.

• Practical experience managing Windows Server, Active Directory, LDAP, and Federation services.

• Proficiency in UNIX/Linux, database security, network security, scripting, and DevOps practices preferred.

• Relevant experience with enterprise applications, security management, systems management, identity management, and/or policy management solutions, particularly in the areas of Identity and Privileged Access

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

In our hybrid early career program, you’ll be paired with a tenured Affirmer and have an opportunity to collaborate in-person 3 days a week out of our New York City, or San Francisco offices. You'll experience the best of both worlds: the in-office experience and remote work. After the one-year, you can remain hybrid, go remote, or stay in an office. Opportunities are available across different tech stacks and teams so that you can find a perfect fit to launch your career with Affirm!

About the Risk & Analytics Team: The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk, to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks. We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

Our Teams (Where You Might Sit): We are hiring multiple Early Career Analyst roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

• Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.

• Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.

• Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.

• Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.

• Servicing and Payments: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.

• International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

About the Role

As an Early Career Analyst in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do

• Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.

• Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.

• Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.

• Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.

• AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, copilots) into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, holding the line on verifying outputs.

What We Look For

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or higher with an expectation that you will complete your most recent full-time degree program by August 2027 or earlier; relevant internships or prior experience in the consumer lending, fintech, or broader financial services industry are highly valued.

• Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Math or a related quantitative field preferred.

• Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.

• Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.

• Basic understanding or deep curiosity about consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.

• Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively.

Pay Grade - I
Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA or NY) per year: $115,000

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

• Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

• Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

• Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

• Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

description:
About the Role

The Technical Support Engineer provides technical support for Cargas Energy customers by troubleshooting and resolving issues related to SQL, JavaScript, .NET code, and SQL servers. In this role, you'll build your knowledge of Cargas Energy while developing your troubleshooting and debugging skills. You'll respond to support tickets, document solutions, and work with teammates to resolve customer issues.

Key Responsibilities

• Respond to support tickets and provide clear updates through the ticketing system or by phone as needed.

• Debug SQL procedures, JavaScript, and .NET code to resolve routine technical issues.

• Monitor and perform basic configuration of SQL servers.

• Troubleshoot customer issues within a Cargas Energy component and escalate more complex issues when needed.

• Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and customer communication.

• Contribute common fixes, scripts, and how-to guidance to the knowledge base.

• Collaborate with teammates to share knowledge and coordinate workloads.

• Meet individual and team productivity, SLA, and KCS-related goals.

• Use approved AI technologies, intelligent automation, and self-service solutions to improve daily operations, enhance the customer experience, increase efficiency, support retention, and reduce ticket volume.

Required Qualifications

• Associate's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 1+ year of experience in a business setting.

• Ability to learn new technology and use available resources to answer questions and solve problems.

• Ability to learn a ticketing system.

• Ability to work independently and with a team.

• Strong listening, conflict resolution, and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

Additional Experience We Value

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

• Experience in software support.

• Experience with ticketing systems such as Zendesk or Jira.

• Understanding of basic SQL queries, networking, logs, error messages, and APIs.

Who We Are

Cargas is an employee-owned software and consulting company where people do meaningful work and share in the success they help create. There’s no one-size-fits-all career path here—you’ll have the tools, support, and flexibility to explore opportunities, build your skills, and grow in ways that are meaningful to you—while contributing to the success of the company. Built on trust and transparency, we practice open-book management, giving employees visibility into company performance so they’re informed, accountable, and connected to our collective goals.

Headquartered in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, we’re committed to sustainable growth for both our business and our people.

Culture, Values, & Work

Our core values—employee ownership, teamwork, and customer care—guide how we work and support one another. We collaborate across teams, welcome diverse ideas, and foster an environment where people feel empowered to contribute. Work arrangements vary by role and team and are designed to balance exceptional customer care with flexibility for personal needs. Our employee tenure exceeds industry benchmarks, and we’ve been recognized as a Best Place to Work in Pennsylvania for two decades.

Ownership & Benefits

Employees share in our success through employee ownership, profit sharing, and bonus programs, supported by a competitive total rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits and cost-saving programs focused on mental, physical, financial, and social well-being.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Cargas Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage all applicants who are excited about our company to apply, even if you don't meet every qualification; you may be a great fit for this role or another opportunity at Cargas!

Formulates, delivers and/or manages projects assigned and works with other stakeholders to achieve desired results.

description:
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

Interested to learn more about our AI CAP Program? We will have our in-person Open House at our NYC office on October 21st RSVP here: ( https://partiful.com/e/B6pLxeJzmsbu74HJ2FeD ) and Chicago office on November 23rd (RSVP here: https://partiful.com/e/53eY3haJAUxm6leyFo5v )

About the Role

We are seeking an AI Product intern who will work on real AI agentic automation problems, designing, prototyping, and developing AI-powered agents to help the business and engineers achieve faster, smarter work. You will collaborate directly with senior engineers and architects, receiving mentorship and design reviews, and gaining exposure to modern GenAI patterns, including agent orchestration, tool-calling, retrieval, and evaluation, within an enterprise and fast-paced fintech environment.

AI tools change every quarter. Your project will use the best models, agent frameworks, and protocols available in summer 2027. You will work on current practice, not today's stack.

Launch your career developing real, impactful AI solutions in the lightning-fast world of fintech!

Program Details
Our summer program will be 10-12 weeks from May - August 2027 with the expectation of being in the office 3-4 days per week, as determined by the sponsor. Compensation will be set at an hourly rate of $35-40 per hour. Top performing associates may have the opportunity to be considered for full-time roles at DriveWealth at the conclusion of the program, based on performance and team needs. Must have a graduation date in 2027 or 2028 .

What You’ll Do

• Design, prototype, and develop agentic AI workflows that automate or augment business or engineering tasks (for example, analysis, triage, documentation, and knowledge synthesis)

• Build internal tools or proof-of-concept systems that combine LLMs, APIs, and automation frameworks into end-to-end agentic solutions

• Experiment with different agent architectures (single-agent vs. multi-agent, planner/executor patterns, human-in-the-loop workflows) and document tradeoffs

• Apply best practices when building AI-driven automation

• Evaluate agent behavior for reliability, correctness, and failure modes, and propose improvements

• Clearly document designs, experiments, and lessons learned so work can be reused or extended by the team

• Demo your work directly to customers and the leadership team

What You’ll Need

• Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field

• Experience programming in Python (for automation, prototyping, and scripting) and SQL

• Familiarity with APIs, JSON, and basic service integration

• Foundational understanding of large language models and how they are used in applications (prompting, tool use, retrieval, etc.)

• Strong curiosity and willingness to explore new, rapidly evolving technologies

• A growth mindset: you ask questions and enjoy experimenting and iterating

• Systems thinking: able to reason about workflows, edge cases, and unintended consequences

• Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining technical ideas to non-engineers

• Ownership mindset: you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks

• Ability to accept feedback and iterate quickly

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth is unable to sponsor an employment Visa at this time.

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid . We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
About the Team

The Reliability Platform team develops the systems that empower engineering groups across all of our brands to own the reliability of their services without needing to become reliability experts. Our offerings enable engineers to define and measure service level objectives (SLOs), surface insights to expedite investigations and drive incidents from declaration through root-cause analysis (RCA) and postmortem. When problems are detected earlier, mitigated faster and followed up on rigorously, our engineers can ship rapidly with confidence and we can collectively ensure that the consumers, merchants and Dashers that depend on DoorDash have the best possible experience.

Reliability Platform’s long-term vision is to operationalize a flywheel of reliability data and insights in order to continually raise the bar for our global engineering organization.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Reliability Platform team, you’ll help design, build, and operate software and infrastructure that deliver on the team’s mission and vision described above in collaboration with expert peers across the Infrastructure and Product organizations. You will work on mission-critical back-end services and pipelines, complex orchestration workflows, self-service platform capabilities and agentic intelligence.

We see and believe in the promise of agentic AI to radically reshape and supercharge how we serve our users and stakeholders while remaining pragmatic and committed to delivering positive business-value outcomes as the ultimate goal.

Some examples of what the Reliability Platform team does:

• Own and drive unification of incident management process and tooling globally across all DoorDash-owned brands

• Create the framework that measures SLO compliance and quality across tens of thousands of endpoints and derive the programmatic insights that ensure engineering teams are informed and accountable for the quality of their products

• Build the internal SRE Agent used in incidents which supports team/domain-specific knowledge bases and obviates legacy runbooks

• Set up MCP for agentic use of Reliability Platform data + tools and enable other Core Infra teams to follow suit

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

•
Deliver Innovative Capabilities : You don’t want to ‘turn the crank’ somewhere, but you want to contribute to strategic thinking and help us drive meaningful continuous improvement.

•
Be Customer Obsessed: We want to learn from our internal customers to ensure we are solving the right challenges, and also share our perspective to influence in areas of expertise

•
Hold a High Quality Bar: We need to lead by example in how we develop, build, test and ship our products to show that we can work at high velocity without sacrificing quality outcomes.

•
Automate Everything: Your first instinct is to ask how toil can be obviated or, failing that, automated away from humans.

•
Shape the Future of Operations : Experiment with agentic AI workflows that can propose, validate, and safely execute production changes — moving DoorDash toward proactive, self-healing systems in step with industry first movers.

We’re excited about you because you have…

•
Platform Engineering Mindset: You think in terms of APIs, abstractions, and workflows — you enjoy building systems that other engineers depend on every day.

•
Proven Experience: You have 2+ years of experience in an infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering role, showing you can deliver and maintain complex systems.

•
Backend Development Skills: You’re fluent in Go (or a similar language) and can design and deliver mission-critical services that are scalable, resilient, performant, and efficient.

•
Cloud/Infra Expertise: You’re comfortable with AWS primitives, security best practices, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

•
SRE Experience: You understand concepts like SLOs, error budgets, and incident response though this is a platform development team, not an SRE/oncall team.

•
AI Alignment: You embrace the use of AI tools to be a more productive and capable engineer. This applies to coding, planning, supporting peers, and everything you do.

•
Curiosity About the Future: You’re excited about automation and agentic, AI-assisted operations and want to help shape how engineers interact with production systems.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here .

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$130,600 — $192,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.

How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.

Data Retention, Privacy & Bias Audit: Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en-us/legal/article/ax-privacy-notice and applicable state laws. In compliance with New York City Local Law 144, the independent bias audit summary for Metaview is publicly available for review at https://trust.warden-ai.com/metaview/application-review .

description:
We are seeking a motivated Software Engineer to support the design, development, integration, testing, and maintenance of complex software systems in a mission-critical environment. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of software engineering principles, experience working in Linux environments, and the ability to collaborate with technical teams to develop reliable and scalable software solutions.

This position provides an opportunity to contribute to a variety of software development initiatives, including data processing, analytics, system integration, and application development.

Eligible candidates may receive a sign-on bonus of up to $10,000, making this an exceptional opportunity to join a mission-critical team supporting national security initiatives.

What will you do?

Design, develop, maintain, and enhance software applications and systems based on documented requirements.

Analyze user and system requirements to determine software design specifications and performance objectives.

Develop new software applications and modify existing code to implement additional features and functionality.

Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects to improve application performance and reliability.

Integrate software components into new or existing systems and operating environments.

Develop and execute software tests to validate functionality, performance, and compliance with design requirements.

Review software components, document test results, and resolve identified issues.

Develop basic database queries to retrieve, analyze, and manipulate data within existing or proposed databases.

Support software development activities within Linux-based environments.

Collaborate with software engineers, systems engineers, and other technical stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.

Participate in technical design discussions involving software architecture, system integration, and component reuse.

Evaluate opportunities to leverage existing software solutions, including Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) and Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) technologies.

Maintain technical documentation and recommend improvements to software development processes, coding standards, and engineering practices.

Do you have what it takes?

US Citizen with TS/SCI with Poly required

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline from an accredited college or university.

Four (4) years of software engineering experience on projects utilizing similar software development processes may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.

Demonstrated experience working with Linux operating systems.

Foundational knowledge of software development principles, methodologies, and best practices.

Understanding of software design, development, debugging, integration, and testing processes.

Ability to analyze technical requirements and contribute to software solutions.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a technical team.

No prior professional software engineering experience is required.

Security Clearance Requirements

Must meet the applicable security clearance and polygraph requirements.

Polygraph must be dated within the last seven (7) years.

description:
Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Curious about how games come to life?

At the intersection of engineering and innovation, we create games that connect millions of players worldwide. If you’re driven to learn, collaborate, and make an impact, the EA SPORTS Academy is your opportunity to launch your career with one of the most iconic names in sports entertainment — EA SPORTS.

Join the 2027 EA SPORTS SE Academy, a unique, full-time program based in Orlando, Florida, designed to accelerate your growth as a Software Engineer. This is a permanent role at Electronic Arts, with your first year focused on guided learning, building relationships, and technical development through the Academy experience.

Your career with EA SPORTS starts with the EA SPORTS SE Academy.

Start your career journey with a three-week immersive onboarding experience — with the first two weeks in-person at our vibrant Vancouver campus (round-trip travel expenses from Orlando to Vancouver will be covered by EA SPORTS) and the third week back at your local studio (Orlando or Vancouver). During this time, you’ll engage in hands-on technical training, experience our studio culture, and build meaningful connections with your cohort, teammates, and mentors.

After the initial three weeks of onboarding, you will transition into an EA SPORTS development team as a permanent full-time Software Engineer. In this position, you will develop your skills through working directly with your development team and by participating in monthly, cohort-based SE Academy learning sessions covering a broad range of disciplines, including Systems, Gameplay, Animation, UI, Rendering, and more.

The EA SPORTS SE Academy experience sets the foundation for your long-term career at EA SPORTS. After completing your first year, you’ll continue in your permanent role with your EA SPORTS development team, applying your skills to world-class games while staying connected through the EA SPORTS Academy alumni network and ongoing professional development opportunities.

Your first year with the EA SPORTS SE Academy is only the beginning of a career journey filled with growth, innovation, and endless possibilities. Get ready to unlock your technical potential by learning from our best-in-class domain experts and grow your career with EA SPORTS.

Must be available for a start date in May 2027, in Orlando for onsite orientation at our vibrant Tiburon studio (located in downtown Orlando). Must then be available to travel to our state-of-the-art EA Vancouver studio in British Columbia, Canada, returning to work onsite at Tiburon onwards, before transitioning into a full-time hybrid position.

description:
The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). Founded in 1934 as the Engineering Experiment Station, GTRI has grown to more than 2,900 employees, supporting eight laboratories in over 20 locations around the country and performing more than $940 million of problem-solving research annually for government and industry. GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

. Students are our top priority.

. We strive for excellence.

. We thrive on diversity.

. We celebrate collaboration.

. We champion innovation.

. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.

. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.

. We act ethically.

. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

The GTRI Robotics and Autonomous Systems Division (RASD) is a growing division focused on robotics and collaborative, autonomous systems. RASD is looking for skilled software engineers to build and develop a Ground Control Station (GCS) Command and Control (C2) system for large, distributed, real-time unmanned systems. You will contribute to the design and implementation of control and interface systems used by field operators. Your work will span multiple technical domains as you identify user needs and develop solutions to improve reliability, scalability, and ease of use. You work will focus on the use and integration of graphics engines, mapping engines, UI/UX specifically for the unmanned robotics C2 domain, messaging libraries and integration, and supporting features and development across various operating systems. Ideal candidates are self-motivated, collaborative-problem solvers who find satisfaction in creating tools that amplify the effectiveness of other engineers.

The Software Engineer designs, develops, and tests software applications and products. Additionally, the Software Engineer manages software development teams, provides technical leadership, and establishes software development lifecycle practices and processes. The Software Engineer is proficient in programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, C, C++, C#, Ruby, Python, Scala, and Groovy. In this role, the Software Engineer requires extensive knowledge of programming languages, software development, computer operating systems, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), DevOps, Application Programming Interface (API) development, container development, and distributed systems. The Software Engineer also applies engineering principles to software creation, manages production releases of software, performs code reviews, merges feature development branches, and analyzes and triages issues. The necessary skill areas for the Software Engineer include programming and coding, fundamentals of computer science, software design and architecture development, algorithms and data structures, information analysis, software debugging and testing, and working on development teams. The Software Engineer also works with sponsors to curate requirements, define sprint work items, set priorities for work backlogs, and organize development teams.

title: Machine Learning Research Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
At Scale , our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force.

Scale's Machine Learning Research team builds the foundation for the next generation of AI systems — pushing the boundaries of what's possible with frontier models while ensuring safety, reliability, and alignment at every step. Our work spans generative AI, reinforcement learning and advanced post-training methods, scalable oversight, synthetic data pipelines, red teaming, and evaluation science.

We are developing a large-scale hybrid human-machine system to power machine learning pipelines for dozens of industry-leading customers. These models and systems form the backbone of Scale's long-term strategy, enabling billions of tasks monthly and supporting some of the most complex and advanced use cases in the AI ecosystem.

As an intern, you'll work on a combination of deeply technical ML applications in production and cutting-edge research problems, with mentorship from world-class researchers and the opportunity to collaborate with leading teams across industry and academia. Interns own real, published or shipped work — not side projects.

Example Projects

• Measure the dangerous capabilities of frontier models and conduct preparedness research

• Research the science and creation of new benchmarks for frontier models

• Develop new methods for training models to excel on extremely difficult reasoning problems that require long chains of thought

• Research reinforcement learning and post-training methods that improve model reliability on high-stakes tasks

• Research scalable oversight protocols that enable humans to produce and quality control reasoning chains beyond their native capabilities

• Study the boundaries of model generalization and capabilities to inform data-driven advancements

• Research synthetic and hybrid data with humans in the loop to scale up high-quality data generation

• Take models currently in production, identify areas for improvement, improve them using retraining and hyperparameter searches, then deploy without regressing on core model characteristics

• Create post-training or agentic solutions that integrate into our ability to deliver applications for enterprise and sector clients

Required to Have

• Currently enrolled in a BS, MS or PhD program with a focus on Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Natural Language Processing, with a graduation date in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028

• Available for a Summer 2027 internship (May/June start dates) in San Francisco Or New York.

• Prior research experience or a track record of publications on LLMs, NLP, multimodal models, agents, safety, evaluation, alignment, or a related field

• Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages, including Python, Javascript, or similar

Ideally You'd Have

• A previous internship in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Adversarial Robustness, Alignment, Evaluation, or Agents

• Experience as a researcher — through internships, full-time roles, or at a lab

• Publications at top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, EMNLP or AAAI, or contributions to open source projects

• Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning, agentic systems, or evaluation infrastructure

How We Work

Our credos shape how we make decisions and work as a team:

• Earn Customer Love — trust is earned with every interaction, every delivery, and every problem we solve

• Team Flow — ideas, energy, and support move freely across teams; optimize for the whole

• Quality is Our Cheat Code — the systems that deliver quality consistently are a structural advantage

• Find the 20% — find the inputs that drive the outcomes and execute them completely

• Write the Market — our research puts us at the frontier, and we bring our partners there first

• Three Moves Ahead — consider the consequences of consequences, and plan accordingly
Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.

Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the locations of San Francisco and New York is:

$120,000 — $150,000 USD

description:
We are looking for a Junior SIEM Data Engineer reporting directly to the Cyber Data Engineering Manager You will support the ingestion, validation, transformation, and documentation of cybersecurity telemetry and enterprise log data used for security monitoring, analytics, reporting, and incident response.

This is an early-ca reer role ideal for recent graduates or professionals with foundational experience in data engineering, cybersecurity, analytics, information systems, or related technical areas. You will work under the guidance of senior engineers to understand source data, validate data quality, document requirements, and support the delivery of reliable security data for downstream cyber analytics and detection use cases.

The team you will be joining is part of Cyber Data & Analytics , a function that is vital to the company as it enables cybersecurity teams to make faster, data-driven decisions and strengthen the firm’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to evolving cyber threats.

High-quality cybersecurity data is foundational to effective threat detection, incident response, risk reporting, observability, automation, and analytics. This role helps ensure that enterprise security telemetry is accurate , complete, searchable, and fit for purposes across cybersecurity platforms and data environments.

Support onboarding and validation of cybersecurity telemetry from enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud services, endpoints, identity systems, networks, and security platforms.

Assist with analyzing source data structures, log formats, field availability, timestamp patterns, and metadata requirements.

S upport data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, routing, and validation activities under the guidance of senior engineers.

Help validate data quality across raw, enriched, curated, and analytics-ready data layers.

Perform basic data checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness, schema consistency, duplicate records, timestamps, and field-level quali ty.

Use query languages and analytical techniques to search, validate , compare, and troubleshoot security telemetry.

Assist with identifying data gaps, missing fields, parsing issues, incorrect timestamps, routing issues, and inconsistencies between source and destination data.

Support documentation of data source requirements, field mappings, data flow diagrams, transformation logic, validation results, and operational runbooks.

Work with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, application, and data engineering teams to understand data requirements and support issue resolution.

Participate in operational support activities such as ticket updates, issue tracking, testing, validation evidence, handoffs, and root cause documentation.

Support second-line troubleshooting for data engineering jobs, pipelines, and data delivery issues impacting cyber data platforms, under the guidance of senior engineers.

Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn security data engineering concepts.

Foundational understanding of data engineering, data analytics, cybersecurity, information systems, or cloud computing concepts.

Basic knowledge of data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, validation, data quality, and data documentation practices.

Ability to use query languages or scripting concepts to analyze, validate , and troubleshoot data.

Strong communication , documentation, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams.

description:
Be part of the team that defends the networks the world depends on

Corelight defends the world’s most sensitive networks—from global commerce to national defense—quietly, relentlessly, and with resolve. As cyber threats grow faster and smarter, we serve as the trusted force behind network resilience, putting elite defense within reach.

By transforming digital footprints from physical, virtual, and cloud networks into actionable insights, we empower defenders to illuminate blind spots and stay ahead of an evolving threat landscape. Built on open-source innovations and fueled by industry leading agentic AI technology, Corelight helps teams to detect advanced threats and close cases with unprecedented clarity and precision.

About the Role

Corelight is looking for an Associate Escalation Engineer to join our Customer Success organization and provide technical support to customers during overnight hours. This US-based, shift-focused role is part of our expansion toward 24/7 support for Federal customers, helping troubleshoot technical issues, maintain case continuity, and ensure customers receive timely assistance outside standard business hours. In this role, you will work alongside experienced Escalation Engineers to investigate customer issues, build technical expertise, and develop hands-on experience across Linux, networking, hardware, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity. This role is a strong fit for someone early in their technical career who enjoys solving problems, learning how systems work, and building depth in a highly technical customer environment.

This is a dedicated overnight shift position supporting our expansion to 24/7 customer support.

• Hours: Overnight coverage between 8:00 PM and 8:00 AM Eastern.

• : Potential shifts include Sunday through Thursday or Monday through Friday.

• Flexibility: Weekend and holiday coverage may be required based on business needs.

What You'll Do

• Investigate and troubleshoot customer technical issues across Corelight products, Linux systems, networking, hardware, and cloud environments.

• Support customer cases and take increasing ownership of issues as technical proficiency develops.

• Use logs, system information, network traffic, and other technical data to help identify the source of technical problems.

• Learn when and how to escalate complex issues to more experienced Escalation Engineers or Engineering.

• Provide clear and timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders on assigned cases.

• Build practical knowledge of Corelight products, Linux, networking, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity concepts.

• Document troubleshooting steps, findings, and resolutions to contribute to shared team knowledge.

• Partner with Escalation Engineering, Engineering, Product Management, Sales Engineering, and other teams to help resolve customer issues.

• Participate in team training, labs, technical projects, and continuous learning.

• Contribute to scripting, tooling, automation, and process improvements as skills develop.

What You'll Bring

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Networking, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent technical training.

• Foundational understanding of computer systems and how devices communicate across networks.

• Basic knowledge of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, IP addressing, and routing.

• Familiarity with Linux or UNIX systems through coursework, technical training, labs, certifications, military experience, or personal projects.

• Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems.

• Interest in technical troubleshooting and the ability to work methodically through unfamiliar problems.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to learn from feedback, ask good questions, and build technical proficiency quickly.

• Strong technical curiosity and interest in networking, systems, and cybersecurity.

• Exposure to scripting, packet analysis, cloud platforms, virtualization, or cybersecurity concepts is a plus.

Notice of Pay Transparency:
The compensation for this position may vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. Depending on the nature and seniority of the role, a percentage of compensation may come in the form of a commission-based or discretionary bonus. Equity and additional benefits will also be awarded.

Compensation Range

$62,000 — $88,000 USD

Why Join Us?

Fueled by investments from top-tier venture capital organizations such as Crowdstrike, Accel and Insight, Corelight is one of the fastest growing network detection and response platforms in the industry. Our passionate team thrives in a collaborative, inclusive, and geographically distributed culture. We embrace diverse perspectives, neurodiversity, curiosity and low ego results - fostering an environment where every innovator can solve the toughest challenges in cybersecurity and contribute their best work.

We are looking forward to meeting you. Check us out at www.corelight.com

description:
Veeva’s Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients.

You’ll work hands-on with innovative Clinical Data Management technology, collaborating directly with internal teams and external customers to design, configure, and implement our clinical data software. In this role, you’ll learn our industry-leading clinical trial cloud platforms and work with cutting-edge AI solutions to transform how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data. Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other.

Your journey begins with an intensive, team-based onboarding program that combines hands-on learning, transparent feedback, and active collaboration to develop the consulting skills and industry knowledge to make an impact right away.

You won't be watching from the sidelines. You will take on real responsibility and work directly with customers to solve clinical data management problems within your first three months.

Grow alongside a supportive team of seasoned leaders and peers who actively champion your development through open communication and actionable feedback.

Advance from Associate to Consultant in less than 2 years. More importantly, you’ll develop the foundation for a successful, long-term career where you can continually expand your technical expertise, lead complex projects, and evolve with our global and diverse team.

description:
Since 1949, Mount Sinai Medical Center has remained committed to providing access to its diverse community. In delivering an unmatched level of clinical expertise, our medical center is committed to recruiting and training top healthcare workers from across the country. We offer the latest in advanced medicine, technology, and comfort in 12 facilities across Miami-Dade (including our 674-bed main campus facility) and Monroe Counties, with 38 medical services, including cancer care, 24/7 emergency care, orthopedics, cardiovascular care, and more. Mount Sinai takes pride in being South Florida's largest private independent not-for-profit hospital, dedicated to continuing the training of the next generation of medical pioneers.

Our hardworking, tight-knit community of more than 4,000 dedicated employees fosters an environment of care and compassion. Each member plays a vital role in our collective mission to deliver excellent healthcare through innovation, education, and research. At Mount Sinai, we take pride in our achievements, aiming to be a beacon of quality healthcare in South Florida. We welcome all healthcare professionals to join our thriving community and contribute to our pursuit for clinical excellence.

We are currently recruiting for Information Technology professionals to join our team and engage immediately with the Epic Electronic Health Record (EHR) initiative. This is a tremendous opportunity to participate in the IT revolution that is changing health care delivery across the United States.

This year, we are focusing on areas such as revenue cycle management, system interoperability, population health management, and health analytics. In addition, there is a continual need to maintain and enhance our Information Technology systems in areas such as physician practices, radiology, lab, pharmacy, ER, OR, anesthesia, clinical documentation, orders, device integration, reporting, informatics/analytics, and much more.

Work along the business office to update hospital reimbursement contracts and automate refund transactions.

Conduct database testing: Write and execute SQL queries to retrieve, update, and delete data, ensuring database integrity and reliability.

Own quality for assigned features and components: Collaborate with product managers and developers on requirements analysis, create detailed test cases, execute comprehensive test suites (functional, integration, regression), and provide final quality sign-off.

Track and report testing progress: Use tools such as JIRA, ADO, or ALM for defect logging and reporting, ensuring transparency of feature quality to the team and stakeholders. Also understanding of CI/CD concepts.

Implement and execute test plans for AI/ML applications: Support QA activities and certify the quality of AI-powered systems, including hands-on testing of chatbots for intent recognition, conversational flow, response accuracy, and edge case handling.

Leverage modern AI tools to enhance workflow: Utilize AI code assistants like GitHub Copilot to accelerate test script development and explore generative AI for tasks such as test data creation and bug report summarization.
Ensure AI reliability and fairness: Execute test cases to identify issues related to bias, fairness, and model robustness, contributing to the overall trustworthiness of AI systems.
Develop and maintain test automation scripts and frameworks using Java and Python.
Have proficiency with test and defect management tools, particularly JIRA or any similar tools.
qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
1 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering role.
Some hands-on experience developing and maintaining test automation scripts and frameworks using Java and Python.
Basic understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and practical experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
A keen interest in or prior experience testing AI-powered applications, such as chatbots or other AI/ML-based systems.
Hands-on experience with the Hybrid Automation frameworks.
Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions).
Exposure to performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling).
Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker)
A passion for learning and staying up to date with the latest trends in AI and software testing.

The pay range is $75,400.00 - $135,700.00

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits .

About us:

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here .

As an Engineer, you serve as a technical specialist delivering the engineering that powers the product. You develop keen insight into the technical architecture and design to deliver robust and scalable software components. You constantly demonstrate the depth of your expertise by solving engineering problems. You are passionate about the quality of software and balance between speed of delivering new features and robustness of the software components you implement. You can handle operational issues with little or no oversight. You actively review code to ensure the software quality and functional accuracy is maintained across the team. You are keen to learn the design and architecture of the product and participate in ceremonies that can influence both.

About Marketing Ad Planning (MAP):

The Marketing Ad Planning (MAP) team builds and maintains a scalable, multi-tenant platform that powers advertising campaign planning and management across Target's marketing ecosystem. Our platform provides foundational capabilities for managing campaign data, configurations, and lifecycle operations, enabling multiple business teams to efficiently plan and execute advertising campaigns.

We focus on building reliable, scalable, and extensible services that support evolving business needs and integrate seamlessly with internal marketing systems and advertising platforms.

Your Impact:

As an Engineer on the Marketing Ad Planning (MAP) platform team, you will contribute to building and maintaining a scalable, multi-tenant advertising campaign management platform. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams across Marketing, Product, and Engineering to deliver reliable, scalable, and extensible capabilities that support campaign planning and activation across multiple business areas.

You will contribute to designing, developing, and enhancing backend services and APIs that support campaign data management, validation, and lifecycle operations. You will work with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integrations to enable seamless data exchange between internal marketing systems and downstream activation platforms. You will help improve platform reliability, performance, and scalability while contributing to technical design and architecture discussions.

You will apply and continue to develop your engineering skills by solving technical problems and delivering high-quality software. You will balance the delivery of new capabilities with writing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested code. You will troubleshoot and resolve operational issues with little or no oversight, participate in code reviews, and contribute to maintaining software quality across the team. You will continue to deepen your understanding of the product, system design, and architecture while actively participating in engineering discussions and team ceremonies.

Core responsibilities are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

Technology Environment:

Relevant experience with the following technologies is recommended; experience with comparable enterprise technologies is also valuable.

• Backend: Java, Kotlin, Groovy

• Frameworks: Spring Boot

• Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB

• Data and Integration: Kafka

• CI/CD: Git, Vela

About You:

4-year degree or equivalent practical experience

• 1+ years of software development experience with at least one full-cycle implementation

• Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java or Kotlin

• Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, application architecture, system design, and distributed systems

• Familiarity with microservices, RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, and modern software development practices

• Experience developing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software applications

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, solve problems, and contribute to improving system reliability and performance

• Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with engineering teams, product partners, and other stakeholders

• Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously develop technical and domain expertise

This position will operate as a Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement based on Target’s needs.  A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member’s core role will need to be performed both onsite at the Target North Campus location the role is assigned to and virtually, depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target.
